dataset.description:
This dataset contains reference grids (vector) and their centroids for harmonized analysis. All the files are geoparquet, they are described below. Production procedure is available at projects GitHub repository (https://github.com/aavotins/HiQBioDiv/blob/main/Templates/TemplateGrids_Vector.R):

  • "tikls100_sauzeme.parquet" contains terrestrial territory of Latvia divided in 100-by-100 m polygon grid cells. Contains fields:
    • "id" feature ID;
    • "yes" a fields with values "1";
    • "tks50km" with ID's of topographic map of Latvia pages (TKS-93 M:50000);
    • "rinda300" with ID's matching file "tikls300_sauszeme.parquet";
    • "ID1km" with ID's matching file "tikls1km_sauszeme.parquet";
    • "rinda500" with ID's matching file "tikls500_sauszeme.parquet";
    • "geom" a {sf} geometry definition field.
  • "tikls300_sauzeme.parquet" contains terrestrial territory of Latvia divided in 300-by-300 m polygon grid cells. Contains fields:
    • "rinda300" feature ID;
    • "x" a {sf} geometry definition field.
  • "tikls500_sauzeme.parquet" contains terrestrial territory of Latvia divided in 500-by-500 m polygon grid cells. Contains fields:
    • "rinda500" feature ID;
    • "tks50km" with ID's of topographic map of Latvia pages (TKS-93 M:50000);
    • "x" a {sf} geometry definition field.
  • "tikls1km_sauzeme.parquet" contains terrestrial territory of Latvia divided in 1000-by-1000 m polygon grid cells. Contains fields:
    • "ID1km" feature ID;
    • "yes" a fields with values "1";
    • "tks50km" with ID's of topographic map of Latvia pages (TKS-93 M:50000);
    • "geometry" a {sf} geometry definition field.
  • "pts100_sauzeme.parquet" contains centroids of file "tikls100_sauszeme.parquet" with their attribute fields;
  • "pts300_sauzeme.parquet" contains centroids of file "tikls300_sauszeme.parquet" with their attribute fields and additional field "tks50km" with ID's of topographic map of Latvia pages (TKS-93 M:50000);
  • "pts500_sauzeme.parquet" contains centroids of file "tikls500_sauszeme.parquet" with their attribute fields;
  • "pts1000_sauszeme.parquet" contains centroids of file "tikls1km_sauszeme.parquet" with their attribute fields;
  • "tks93_50km.parquet" contains topographic map of Latvia pages (TKS-93 M:50000). Contains fields:
  • "NOSAUKUMS" with a page name;
  • "NUMURS" with a page number;
  • "Shape_Length" an attribute from ESRI File Geodatabase;
  • "Shape_Area" an attribute from ESRI File Geodatabase;
  • "Shape" a {sf} geometry definition field;
  • All the above mentioned files are stored also as layers in geopakage file "vector_grids.gpkg" having the same names and attributes.

dmp.description:
The Project aims to provide new knowledge on EU-protected species and habitats with unfavourable or unknown conservation status and bird species with declining or unknown trends for use in nature conservation planning, climate change mitigation, and socio-economic assessments in Latvia.

The specific objectives of the project are:
  1. to create new spatially explicit species- and habitat-specific nationwide biodiversity data layers;
  2. to carry out site prioritisation for EU-protected species and habitat conservation and to propose improvements to the protected area network;
  3. to carry out in-depth ecological studies of EU-protected species and habitats with unknown or unfavourable conservation status;
  4. to demonstrate the use of the datasets created by the project and those already available in protected area network assessments, socio-economic and climate impact assessments, and management planning.

Methodology. The project concept consists of 4 interdependent modules: 1) data preparation and preprocessing; 2) species distribution modelling and spatial conservation prioritisation; 3) in-depth studies of selected EU-protected species and habitats with unfavourable conservation status; and 4) integrated socio-ecological analysis and evaluation. Additionally, the 5th module has a task to manage the project and collect, summarise, and disseminate the results achieved in the other modules.

Here, a description of the workflow and data (input, byproducts and results) will be given, which refers to various vector and raster geodatabases, their geoprocessed and analytical outputs.
